refute_b.reason: SEWIP appears once in the index - 2312's 'Improvement Program (SEWIP)', the narrative's own fragment of Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program - and 2312 also owns a Block 3 article ('B3-HIGH GAIN HIGH SENSITIVITY (HGHS)'), so Block 3 is this line's increment, not another's; the only other AN/SLQ-32 row is 3620 Coast Guard Equipment, which a fiscal 2021 OPN Navy production option does not fit.
